stories.title: Usa, Bessent: “Dal 23 settembre le compagnie aeree iraniane non potranno più volare”

en.title: USA, Bessent: Iranian airlines will no longer be able to fly from September 23
en.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that all Iranian airlines will be forced to cease operations starting September 23 due to security concerns.

stories.title: Chico Forti ottiene la semilibertà: continuerà a lavorare in un’azienda agricola

en.title: Chico Forti obtains semi-freedom: will continue working on an agricultural farm
en.summary: A man detained in Verona and previously imprisoned for 25 years in Florida on a murder charge has been granted semi-liberty with the condition of continued farm employment.

stories.title: Chico Forti in semilibertà: potrà andare a trovare l’anziana madre in Trentino

en.title: Chico Forti on semi-freedom: will be able to visit his elderly mother in Trentino
en.summary: A man in semi-liberty status will be permitted to visit his elderly mother, with authorities awaiting a decision on conditional release that would eliminate nightly incarceration.

stories.title: La morte di Denise Cosco, verifiche della procura su eventuali contatti con il padre

en.title: The death of Denise Cosco, prosecutor verification of possible contacts with her father
en.summary: Prosecutors are investigating potential communications between a deceased woman and her father by examining her mobile phone and email records.

stories.title: Morte di Denise Cosco, verifiche su eventuali contatti con il padre

en.title: Death of Denise Cosco, checks on possible contacts with father
en.summary: Prosecutors are awaiting results from analysis of the girl's mobile phone. The man is in custody.

stories.title: Esplosione Calenzano, 6 dipendenti Eni chiedono patteggiare

en.title: Calenzano explosion, 6 Eni employees seek plea agreement
en.summary: Six employees involved in a workplace explosion are requesting plea deals. Three other individuals are facing referral to trial.

stories.title: Tragedia di Calenzano: sei indagati chiedono di patteggiare, tre verso il rinvio a giudizio

en.title: Calenzano tragedy: six defendants seek plea agreement, three face trial
en.summary: The Prato Public Prosecutor's Office supports six plea agreement requests. Three others are referred to trial. The explosion resulted in six deaths.

stories.title: Il Tribunale concede la semilibertà a Chico Forti

en.title: Court grants Chico Forti semi-liberty
en.summary: A man held at Montorio prison in Verona, who received a life sentence in the United States for a 1998 death in Miami, has been granted partial release.

stories.title: Testate escluse da Trump dalla Casa Bianca: CNN, Politico e MsNow fanno causa al governo

en.title: News outlets excluded by Trump from White House: CNN, Politico and MsNow sue government
en.summary: Several television news organizations have filed a lawsuit against the government based on First Amendment protections, challenging their exclusion from White House access and asserting that government should not control press reporting.

stories.title: Chi è la candidata della Linke a Berlino Elif Eralp, già ribattezzata la "Mamdani" tedesca

en.title: Who is Die Linke's candidate in Berlin Elif Eralp, already nicknamed the German "Mamdani"
en.summary: The 45-year-old migrant rights lawyer and daughter of Turkish union activists campaigns on issues affecting younger voters, particularly the housing affordability crisis in Berlin, drawing comparisons to New York's mayor approach.

stories.title: Cnn, MsNow e Politico fanno causa a Trump per il divieto di accesso alla Casa Bianca. E le altre tv annunciano il boicottaggio

en.title: CNN, MSNow and Politico sue Trump for ban from White House. Other networks announce boycott
en.summary: Three news outlets filed lawsuits against Trump citing First Amendment protections for press freedom after being denied White House access. Additional networks said they would stop covering his activities in solidarity.

stories.title: Cnn, MsNow e Politico fanno causa a Trump: accesso negato alla Casa Bianca. Stop copertura attività

en.title: CNN, MSNow and Politico sue Trump: White House access denied. Coverage stops
en.summary: Three news organizations sued over First Amendment violations following their White House ban. ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC joined by ceasing coverage of Trump's official activities and events.

stories.title: Grimaldi prende in consegna una nuova nave con tecnologie ecocompatibili

en.title: Grimaldi takes delivery of new ship with eco-friendly technologies
en.summary: Shipping company Grimaldi received the Grande Egitto, a new pure car and truck carrier vessel built by China Merchants Heavy Industries Jiangsu, expanding its fleet capacity.

stories.title: Fresenius Kabi inaugura la nuova linea, investimento da 28 milioni

en.title: Fresenius Kabi opens new production line with 28 million euro investment
en.summary: Pharmaceutical company Fresenius Kabi invested over 28 million euros in a new production line as part of a larger three-year Italian investment plan worth 100 million euros total.

stories.title: Ferrero, arriva il premio di risultato, 2.500 euro per i dipendenti italiani

en.title: Ferrero announces performance bonus of 2,500 euros for Italian employees
en.summary: Ferrero management and unions agreed on a performance-based bonus of 2,500 euros to be paid to Italian workers in October as established by company collective agreement.

stories.title: Riciclo tessile, Igers inaugura impianto da 8 milioni di euro

en.title: Textile recycling: Igers inaugurates 8 million euro facility
en.summary: Igers, a Milan-based company, opened a textile waste recycling plant in Novara with an annual capacity of 19,000 tonnes. The facility represents an 8 million euro investment.

stories.title: Sanremo, il nuovo regolamento 2027: l’AI resta fuori delle canzoni

en.title: Sanremo, the new 2027 regulation: AI stays out of songs
en.summary: The new regulations for the 2027 Sanremo Festival explicitly prohibit the use of artificial intelligence in competition songs, establishing this principle in the festival's official rules.
